hypernyms.def: a terrestrial or aquatic flesh-eating mammal
exp: terrestrial carnivores have four or five clawed digits on each limb
hypernyms.gloss: a terrestrial or aquatic flesh-eating mammal; "terrestrial carnivores have four or five clawed digits on each limb"

exp: all mammals except monotremes and marsupials
hypernyms.gloss: mammals having a placenta; all mammals except monotremes and marsupials

hypernyms.def: any warm-blooded vertebrate having the skin more or less covered with hair
exp: young are born alive except for the small subclass of monotremes and nourished with milk
hypernyms.gloss: any warm-blooded vertebrate having the skin more or less covered with hair; young are born alive except for the small subclass of monotremes and nourished with milk

hypernyms.def: animals having a bony or cartilaginous skeleton with a segmented spinal column and a large brain enclosed in a skull or cranium
hypernyms.gloss: animals having a bony or cartilaginous skeleton with a segmented spinal column and a large brain enclosed in a skull or cranium

hypernyms.def: any animal of the phylum Chordata having a notochord or spinal column
hypernyms.gloss: any animal of the phylum Chordata having a notochord or spinal column

hypernyms.def: a living organism characterized by voluntary movement
hypernyms.gloss: a living organism characterized by voluntary movement

hypernyms.def: a living thing that has (or can develop) the ability to act or function independently
hypernyms.gloss: a living thing that has (or can develop) the ability to act or function independently

hypernyms.def: an assemblage of parts that is regarded as a single entity
exp: how big is that part compared to the whole?
hypernyms.gloss: an assemblage of parts that is regarded as a single entity; "how big is that part compared to the whole?"; "the team is a unit"

exp: an entity that can cast a shadow
it was full of rackets, balls and other objects
hypernyms.gloss: a tangible and visible entity; an entity that can cast a shadow; "it was full of rackets, balls and other objects"

hypernyms.def: an entity that has physical existence
hypernyms.gloss: an entity that has physical existence

hypernyms.def: that which is perceived or known or inferred to have its own distinct existence (living or nonliving)
hypernyms.gloss: that which is perceived or known or inferred to have its own distinct existence (living or nonliving)

word.def: any of various lithe-bodied roundheaded fissiped mammals, many with retractile claws
word.gloss: any of various lithe-bodied roundheaded fissiped mammals, many with retractile claws
